subset.rationale: absl::StatusOr<T> bound as three real specializations (int/std::string/double): ok(), status() (returns const Status& so Status+StatusCode are bound in-module), IgnoreError(). All of StatusOr's value/converting CONSTRUCTORS are templates (enable_if'd U&&), which the binder skips by design, so the sotest fixture namespace supplies ok_*/err_* factories (the Duration/Time pattern). FINDING: value()/operator*/operator-> are declared in the PRIVATE base internal_statusor::OperatorBase<T> and re-exported via using-declarations -- invisible to the binder (using-decls are not enumerable members; private bases are correctly not flattened), so value access goes through get_* fixture accessors (which still exercise the real throw-on-error path).
skipped_features: value()/operator*/operator-> (using-redeclared from a PRIVATE base; not enumerable -- get_* fixtures instead; candidate binder investigation alongside Wave-2 base flattening)
value construction/assignment from Python literals (all converting ctors are templates; factories instead)
